name: Ozark Biomedical
old_description: I would like you to know that I’ve been doing business with Ozark Biomedical since 2007 and I am very impressed with the work the techs perform on the centrifuge PC boards and motors.
about:
Ozark Biomedical operates from Beebe, Arkansas, where it was founded in 2007. The company has served the centrifuge market for over 15 years, building a reputation for repair and parts supply.

The company specializes in centrifuge repair services and the supply of replacement parts for a wide range of models from manufacturers such as Beckman, Thermo Fisher, Eppendorf, and Hettich. Its workshop remanufactures motors, latches, and circuit boards to meet or exceed original OEM specifications, and it offers many components on an exchange basis with a core‑charge program. The inventory covers hundreds of centrifuge models across dozens of brands.

Customers include clinical laboratories, pharmaceutical research facilities, and medical‑device service providers that rely on centrifuges for sample preparation. The company supports equipment used in diagnostics, bioprocessing, and life‑science research, providing extended warranties with optional on‑site service.

Ozark Biomedical emphasizes that its remanufacturing process restores every component to original specifications, and its exchange program reduces cost and downtime for clients. The firm holds ISO 9001 certification and promotes a customer‑service approach that includes direct technical support.

Whether you are planning a new building, bridge component, or another structural project, we can supply the materials and expertise needed for dependable results, including structural steel in Branson, MO and throughout Southwest Missouri.
about:

The company sources its raw steel directly from American mills and operates as a steel processor, fabricator, and stocking distributor for the region's construction market.

The firm provides steel processing services including precision cutting and breaking to exact specifications, custom metal fabrication of structural components, and a stocked inventory of structural beams, columns, roofing, and siding materials. It also sells cut-to-size pieces and offers pickup and delivery across its service area. The shop uses modern equipment to hold tight tolerances on fabricated parts, though specific machine models and facility size are not disclosed.

Ozark Mountain Steel serves residential, commercial, and industrial construction contractors, as well as public infrastructure projects. Notable regional projects include custom components for the Wonders of Wildlife National Museum & Aquarium, structural steel for the MSU Football Stadium, and materials for local bridge construction. The company also supports smaller residential builds and agricultural structures throughout Southwest Missouri.

The company emphasizes its third-generation ownership, direct-from-mill sourcing, and decades of experience as differentiators. Free estimates, project quotes, and a willingness to handle jobs of any size are cited as reasons customers choose the firm.

name: PDI Duct
old_description: Custom fabricated PVC and CPVC ductwork, pipe fittings, and industrial ventilation systems designed for corrosive environments.
about:
Based in North Chelmsford, Massachusetts, Plastic Design Industries (operating as PDI Duct) has been fabricating PVC and CPVC duct systems since 1976. The company began as Plastic Design Inc. and has spent nearly five decades specializing in thermoplastic fabrication for corrosive environments.

The company operates a 30,000-square-foot facility with a 21,000-square-foot manufacturing floor equipped for nitrogen-purged hot-gas welding, CNC machining, CO2 laser cutting, pipe fusion, and deionized-water testing. It produces standard fittings such as elbows, reducers, saddles, dampers, and blast gates in diameters from 6 to 24 inches, as well as custom-fabricated duct runs, manifolds, and transitions. Production spans one-off prototypes through full production runs.

PDI Duct serves engineers, contractors, and facility teams in chemical processing, wastewater treatment, semiconductor manufacturing, pharmaceutical production, testing laboratories, and general industrial ventilation and manufacturing plants. Its systems handle corrosive air handling, fume exhaust, and process applications where metal ductwork would fail.

The company emphasizes its dual-material expertise in PVC and CPVC, in-house design-to-delivery control, and certifications including ISO 9001:2015 and IPC-A-620 welding standards to ensure leak-resistant, durable installations.

name: PEC Solar Company
old_description: Nestled in the rural and wooded landscapes of Wisconsin, PEC Solar provides custom PV Solar design and installation to residential homes. We’re here to help you lower the energy costs to power your home and help the environment at the same time. Why pay for power from the utility company when you can make it yourself?
about:
PEC Solar Company operates from a location just outside Rio, Wisconsin, in the rural woodlands of the state. The locally owned firm was established by professionals with over 14 years of electrical engineering experience, though a precise founding year is not publicly disclosed. The company focuses on residential solar installations across southern Wisconsin, including the Madison and Milwaukee metropolitan areas.

The company delivers turnkey photovoltaic services: custom system design, permitting, shading analysis using drone-based 3D mapping, installation of roof- or ground-mounted arrays, and ongoing monitoring of panel-level and whole-home energy production. It also installs electric-vehicle charging stations, whole-home battery storage, and natural-gas or propane backup generators, and provides repair service for existing solar arrays.

PEC Solar serves exclusively residential customers in southern Wisconsin. Its projects range from single-family homes to properties with complex shading challenges, and the firm coordinates utility interconnection and incentive paperwork on the homeowner’s behalf.

The company distinguishes itself through its engineering credentials: it holds professional engineering licenses in 11 states, employs the only NABCEP-certified PV Design Specialist in Wisconsin, and maintains REC Certified Solar Professional status alongside a master electrician license and electrical contractor license. It emphasizes a no-pressure sales approach, vetted component selection, and meticulous installation practices.

name: PM Assembly LLC
old_description: In 2002, we began as a sole proprietor in Dallas, TX with one printer, one pick-and-place machine, one reflow oven and a couple of hand solder workstations. Seventeen years later we have two full SMT lines including five pick-and-place machines for a top placement rating of 53k components per hour. We have added Wave Solder, Selective Solder, Cut-and-Clinch, AOI, X-Ray, In-Circuit Test and BGA Rework, among other capabilities.
about:
PM Assembly LLC was founded in 2002 as a sole proprietorship in Dallas, Texas, starting with a single printer, pick-and-place machine, reflow oven, and a few hand-solder workstations. The operation later moved to a 6,000-square-foot, environmentally friendly facility in Farmersville, Texas.

The company runs two full surface-mount technology (SMT) lines equipped with five pick-and-place machines capable of a peak placement rate of 53,000 components per hour. Its process portfolio includes wave solder, selective solder, cut-and-clinch, automated optical inspection (AOI), X-ray inspection, in-circuit test (ICT), BGA rework, through-hole assembly, and mechanical assembly.

PM Assembly serves engineers, large corporations, and independent entrepreneurs across the Dallas–Fort Worth metro area and nationwide, handling both prototype runs and ongoing production orders.

The founders emphasize customer service over rapid expansion, describing themselves as "the engineer's friend" and building long-term reliability into every assembly through IPC-certified inspectors and functional testing performed to customer-supplied procedures.
